name: @athena/chrome-extension
description: Athena Chrome extension companion. PRD F15.

scripts.build: node esbuild.config.mjs && cp src/manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp src/popup/popup.html dist/popup.html && mkdir -p dist/icons && cp src/icons/*.png dist/icons/ && mkdir -p dist/offscreen && cp src/offscreen/index.html dist/offscreen/index.html && cp src/offscreen/pcm-worklet.js dist/offscreen/pcm-worklet.js && mkdir -p dist/permission && cp src/permission/index.html dist/permission/index.html
scripts.build:prod: ATHENA_PROD=1 node esbuild.config.mjs && cp src/manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp src/popup/popup.html dist/popup.html && mkdir -p dist/icons && cp src/icons/*.png dist/icons/ && mkdir -p dist/offscreen && cp src/offscreen/index.html dist/offscreen/index.html && cp src/offscreen/pcm-worklet.js dist/offscreen/pcm-worklet.js && mkdir -p dist/permission && cp src/permission/index.html dist/permission/index.html
